name: demarkus
description: Plugins that connect Claude Code to a demarkus server.

plugins.name: demarkus-memory
plugins.description: Zero-config local memory for Claude Code. Spawns a local demarkus-server and wires MCP tools for fetch/publish/append/graph/lookup over your own versioned markdown store, and self-documents sessions to it. With a knowledge system joined, /promote lifts ready notes up to the shared catalog and /soul-refresh pulls them back as they evolve.

plugins.name: demarkus-knowledge
plugins.description: Join an organizational demarkus knowledge system from Claude Code — a shared, broker-fronted, versioned markdown catalog. Steers sessions to the shared catalog first, makes it easy to navigate, enforces a publish tag-gate, and curates promoted notes into it via the knowledge-promote cascade. No local server or binaries.
